# Identical-binary process control

Unchanged source rebuilt; both object and both descriptor SHA256 values equal the preserved original installation. One fresh process per installation, five event/wall samples per case. This measures observed process/device variation, not a bound on all possible variation or a significance test. Separate from the three-process/build acceptance pool.
